title: BLS12-381 plain G1 ECDLP (bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain): pairing transfer to two G_T logarithms, (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS with a certified single-trial descent, at expected work 2^112.334717540845

claims.statement: Exploratory-v1 analytic claim for track bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain: given T = [x]P_0 in G_1 (uniform x in 0..r-1, T = O -> x = 0, no auxiliary powers), transfer through the public pairing to z_T = e(T, Q_0) and h = e(P_0, Q_0), recover two gamma_0-blinded virtual logarithms in (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS and return x = V(z_T) V(h)^-1 mod r (checked by [x]P_0 = T). Rows are kept in dense F_p12 multiplication units (C = 20,000 baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A Ir) and converted exactly x10 to G1 units (C = 2,000). Opened-run expected work E[W_run] <= 2^110.3698 core units = sum of the section-8 rows: relation collection 2^110.0006, linear algebra 2^107.2484, two individual logarithms 2^106.7106 (76-node plan; every descent slot sieves one lattice L_{Q,p_rand} that first passes a per-lattice yield certificate mu(L) >= 15 at error 1e-9, so each slot fails with probability <= e^-15 + 1e-9 under the within-ball independence premise H5; Boole over 3,472 slots gives tree failure <= 0.0010656 per fresh-e boot renewal), and smaller rows. Every run is cut by a hard meter at 2^123 core units; opened-run success >= 0.9990; a run gate with K = 7201431620367092223 gives cold success >= 0.39 and E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64) * 10 * (2^110.3698 + 2^66) < 2^112.334717540845 G1 units. No prior verdict or score is a premise.
